statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-116325 (PostgreSQL reindexdb index name quoting allows SQL injection) affects only PostgreSQL 17 and 18. The PostgreSQL security page, https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116325/, says versions before PostgreSQL 17 are unaffected and lists 18.7 and 17.12 as the only fixed releases, and the 16.16 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/16.16/, do not list it. The flaw is in the catalog query reindexdb builds to run index-level REINDEX in parallel (--jobs with --index). The fix, https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/7820c8c397d2234980f77308f5de07eb9c912820, changes src/bin/scripts/reindexdb.c and common.c, says it is back-patched through 17, and names the commit that added index-level REINDEX with multiple jobs as the origin. PostgreSQL 16's reindexdb has no such query: at REL_16_16 it stops with "cannot use multiple jobs to reindex indexes" when --jobs and --index are combined, https://github.com/postgres/postgres/blob/REL_16_16/src/bin/scripts/reindexdb.c . Alpine's postgresql16 16.16-r0 lists CVE-2026-116325 in its secfixes, https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/859fa0795e895af033fab32094a83301f2b4d8ff/community/postgresql16/APKBUILD, but upstream's own record places PostgreSQL 16 outside the affected range, and none of the Alpine patches applied in that APKBUILD touch reindexdb. This owner covers the packages built from Alpine's postgresql16 recipe: postgresql16 and its subpackages postgresql16-client, -contrib, -contrib-jit, -dev, -doc, -jit, -openrc, -plperl, -plperl-contrib, -plpython3, -plpython3-contrib and -pltcl. We checked every package built from that source in the DHI Alpine 3.23 repository, 4 builds (16.13-r0, 16.14-r0, 16.15-r0 and 16.16-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, each against its index checksum; 16.14-r0 for x86_64 is published without the -plperl-contrib, -plpython3, -plpython3-contrib and -pltcl subpackages. The server binary /usr/libexec/postgresql16/postgres in each build reports its release on both architectures: PostgreSQL 16.13 in 16.13-r0, PostgreSQL 16.14 in 16.14-r0, PostgreSQL 16.15 in 16.15-r0 and PostgreSQL 16.16 in 16.16-r0. In every build, on both architectures, /usr/libexec/postgresql16/reindexdb in postgresql16-client contains the "cannot use multiple jobs to reindex indexes" message and does not contain the parallel index query text "indexrelid OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) ANY(ARRAY"; the same byte search finds that text in /usr/libexec/postgresql17/reindexdb of the postgresql17-client 17.11-r0 and 17.12-r0 packages for Alpine 3.23 on both architectures. The vulnerable code is not present.

statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-116325 (PostgreSQL reindexdb index name quoting allows SQL injection): a crafted index name embedded in the parallel catalog query that reindexdb builds for --jobs with --index lets an object creator run arbitrary SQL as the database user running reindexdb. PostgreSQL states that versions before 17 are unaffected. It is fixed upstream in PostgreSQL 17.12 for major version 17. The PostgreSQL security page, https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116325/, lists 17.12 as the fixed release for 17, and the 17.12 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/17.12/, list this CVE. The fix on the REL_17_STABLE branch is commit https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/2680b0781ac853736be8c93f85c6f581ef5d805f, which carries the trailer "Security: CVE-2026-116325", is contained in the REL_17_12 tag and not in REL_17_11, and changes src/bin/scripts/reindexdb.c so that each index name given with --index is resolved to a quoted identifier and then added to the parallel catalog query as a properly escaped string literal, instead of being placed between single quotes without escaping; it also adds a comment in src/bin/scripts/common.c and a regression test. Alpine's postgresql17 17.12-r0 on the 3.23-stable branch upgrades to the upstream 17.12 release and lists CVE-2026-116325 under 17.12-r0 in its secfixes: https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/ce22298320177ae25085d86fbf3b4fc1150c16a2/main/postgresql17/APKBUILD. None of the Alpine patches applied in that APKBUILD change the files the fix touches. The DHI postgresql17 17.12-r0 packages for Alpine 3.23 are built from that APKBUILD and the upstream PostgreSQL 17.12 source tarball. The DHI Alpine 3.23 package repository (x86_64 and aarch64) publishes packages built from source postgresql17 at 17.7-r0, 17.8-r0, 17.9-r0, 17.10-r0, 17.11-r0 and 17.12-r0; we downloaded the packages named below for every one of those builds on both architectures, each checked against its index checksum. The reindexdb program is usr/libexec/postgresql17/reindexdb, which the postgresql17-client subpackage ships in every published build on both architectures; it reports the same release as the server in every build. In the 17.12-r0 build the postgres server binary, usr/libexec/postgresql17/postgres, reports PostgreSQL 17.12 on both x86_64 and aarch64, and in each earlier build (17.7-r0, 17.8-r0, 17.9-r0, 17.10-r0 and 17.11-r0) it reports that older 17.x release on both architectures. The reindexdb program in 17.12-r0 builds the catalog query without the quote characters around the index list (the query text ends in "]::pg_catalog.regclass[])"), while every earlier build still contains the "ANY(ARRAY['" and "']::pg_catalog.regclass[])" text the fix removes, on both architectures. The earlier builds are upstream releases before 17.12, so they are affected; 17.12-r0 and later carry the fix.

CVE-2026-116325 (PostgreSQL reindexdb index name quoting allows SQL injection) is fixed upstream in PostgreSQL 18.7 for major version 18. PostgreSQL lists only major versions 17 and 18 as affected. The PostgreSQL security page, https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116325/, lists 18.7 as the fixed release for 18, the 18.7 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/18.7/, list this CVE, and the CVE record, https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-116325, lists 18 as affected before 18.7. The fix on the REL_18_STABLE branch is commit https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/aac5e6f5038a4d3b9a6d71b30e57fd9c9436033c, which carries the trailer "Security: CVE-2026-116325", is contained in the REL_18_7 tag and not in REL_18_6, and changes get_parallel_tabidx_list() in src/bin/scripts/reindexdb.c to pass each index name as an escaped string literal in the catalog query used for reindexdb --jobs with --index, and adds a comment in src/bin/scripts/common.c; its other change is a test. Alpine's postgresql18 18.7-r0 on the 3.23-stable branch upgrades to the upstream 18.7 release and lists CVE-2026-116325 under 18.7-r0 in its secfixes: https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/59a1f1d230675807d5a95a0c1e57ba5d640ba039/main/postgresql18/APKBUILD. None of the Alpine patches applied in that APKBUILD change the files the fix touches. The DHI postgresql18 18.7-r0 packages for Alpine 3.23 are built from that APKBUILD and the upstream PostgreSQL 18.7 source tarball. The DHI Alpine 3.23 package repository (main and security, x86_64 and aarch64) publishes packages built from source postgresql18 at 18.1-r0, 18.2-r0, 18.3-r0, 18.4-r0, 18.6-r0 and 18.7-r0. The vulnerable code is in reindexdb, usr/libexec/postgresql18/reindexdb, which the postgresql18-client subpackage ships in every published build on both architectures. In the 18.7-r0 build the postgres server binary reports PostgreSQL 18.7 on both x86_64 and aarch64, and in each earlier build (18.1-r0, 18.2-r0, 18.3-r0, 18.4-r0 and 18.6-r0) it reports that older 18.x release on both architectures. The reindexdb program in every build before 18.7-r0 contains the vulnerable query text, which puts each index name between single quotes inside ANY(ARRAY[...]), on both architectures; the reindexdb program in the 18.7-r0 build no longer contains that text, on both architectures. The earlier builds are upstream releases before 18.7, so they are affected; 18.7-r0 and later carry the fix.

CVE-2026-116325 (PostgreSQL reindexdb index name quoting allows SQL injection) is fixed upstream in PostgreSQL 17.12 for the 17 major version: https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116325/ and the 17.12 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/17.12/; the CVE record, https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-116325, lists 17 as affected before 17.12. Debian fixed it in postgresql-17 17.12-0+deb13u1 (DSA-6625-1): https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-116325. The lowest published build of this owner at PostgreSQL 17.12 is 17.12-0, whose postgres server binary reports PostgreSQL 17.12 on both amd64 and arm64; the later build of Debian's 17.12-0+deb13u1 also reports 17.12. The earlier builds, 17.11-1 and the builds of Debian's 17.10-0+deb13u1 and 17.11-0+deb13u1, are PostgreSQL 17.10 or 17.11 (the published 17.11-1 and 17.11-0+deb13u1 server binaries report PostgreSQL 17.11) and sort below 17.12-0, so they are affected. reindexdb is built from the same source and release as the server.
